SMPC Donates “ Dinsaw” RobotsI. SMPC Overview: CSR Activities
In 2025, SMPC donated its “ Dinsaw” and “ DinsawMini” medical robots, together with related equipment, to five hospitals in 
University of Phayao Hospital, Phayao Hospital, Khun Chueang Thammikarat Camp Hospital, Dok Khamtai Hospital, and Mae Chai 
Hospital. The initiative supported medical personnel and enhanced patient care efficiency, reflecting the Company’s commitmen t to 
sustainable social responsibility alongside its business growth.
